senses.gloss: (III)--a Mt. west of the शितोद. वा. ३६. २७.

(I)--an aged prostitute of the Videha city; her story as narrated by अवधूत to Yadu is as follows; she spent her life as a public woman living by earning money every day from one paramour or other; one night she did not get a paramour though she waited to the middle of the night; she then grew disgusted with her life and turned her thought on Hari which resulted in her restful sleep;
1: भा. XI. 8. २२-44.
her view of life cited by the Gopis to Uddhava.
2: Ib. X. ४७. ४७.
--a तीर्थम् of the नर्मदा; good to give away a cow or to die there. M. १९१. ३२-36.
(I)--a यक्ष; a son of पुण्यजनी and मणि- bhadra. Br. III. 7. १२३.
(II)--a son of लान्गली, an अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. २००.

--one of the eleven Rudras; an epithet of महेश्वर;
1: M. 5. ३०; 6. १३; १२. 8; २३. ३६, ४१; ९५. ३८; १५४. ११८, १९४, ३९५, ४१०.
married सती; has the bull for the riding animal and is the guardian deity for the N. E.
2: Ib. ६०. ११; ६७. १६.
